verdict.rationale: Muse connects directly to real user accounts (email, calendar, Instagram, finances) and executes real actions (purchases, cancellations) with approval, but no evidence describes a separate sandbox/test environment distinct from production data — the VM described (muse-docs-1, muse-supp-vm-files-export) is the agent's own working filesystem, not a staging environment for testing against non-production data. missing for 10: any documented sandbox/test mode, staging environment, or mock-data option that lets a user validate agent behavior without touching real connected accounts.
